name: [GRANNY] Hello Neighbor Diablo’s Circus
desc:
THE REBORN UPDATE HAS ARRIVED!

In Hello Neighbor: Diablo’s Circus, the Intruders (Players) work together to unlock various rooms, all while a player-controlled Neighbor hunts them down. Once the players manage to unlock the basement, one player spawns as the Neighbor, only to be automatically ejected afterward.

Exploits/Cheating will result in a permanent ban, don't do it.

Credits to Tiny Build and Eerie Guest Studios.
